api_submission: Keep the API payload disabled until the maintainer verifies immutable version-tag behavior on the intended repository plan and explicitly authorizes repository settings changes.
signed_tag_authorization: Signed annotated version tags remain authorized by the existing release preflight: git verify-tag with .github/release-allowed-signers. The ruleset payload protects tag ref updates and deletions; it does not verify tag objects.

steps: Record the incident, version tag, source commit, and intended recovery in a tracked issue before changing repository rules.
Never delete, move, or reuse an existing version tag; create a new signed annotated version tag only after CI quality aggregate succeeds for the exact commit.
If signing is blocked, verify the configured release signer and allowed-signers file through the existing release preflight; do not bypass verification or retag an existing release.

If an administrative ruleset change is unavoidable, make the smallest time-bounded change through the GitHub ruleset UI or API, capture its audit entry, and restore protection before the next release.
